prompt: Create ONE original photorealistic architectural photograph, native SQUARE 1:1 composition, showing a credible EXTERIOR SIDING RENOVATION IN PROGRESS on an existing modest single-family Quebec bungalow with pitched gable roofs. Natural summer daylight, Quebec maple and spruce trees, modest landscaping retained, safe believable work-site layout, realistic textures and construction sequencing, premium documentary architectural photography, restrained natural colours, straight verticals and no excessive wide-angle distortion. No interior renovation, no demolition ruin, no giant machinery, no text, no manufacturer branding, no printed logos on membrane, no addresses, signs, watermark, collage, before/after split, UI mockup or schematic drawing. This is an original illustrative scene for project selection, not a documented MIR project or a certified product installation.
